name: N-Caltech101 Evaluation Protocol
description: > Released artefacts accompanying the manuscript *A Reproducible Evaluation > Protocol for Event-Based Object Detection on N-Caltech101: Deterministic > Splits, Validated Uncertainty, and Comparable Reporting*. > > Contents: the released protocol specification with the machine-readable > frozen-command / SHA-256 record; the deterministic class-stratified 80/10/10 > split, class order and tier/frequency tables; the path, semantics-alignment > and command-integrity gates; evaluation tooling (frozen-command runner, C2 > interval computation, sensitivity sweep); the coverage-simulation studies > (Gaussian, binary, rank-based) with their recalibrations, the > pseudoreplication and detection-density analyses, and the repeat-execution > identity check; reference results and per-class tables for the two > leakage-free retrained models; figure sources; and the manuscript PDF. > > The archive contains no dataset content, no training checkpoints, no run > logs, and no personal identifiers.
